# opnsense_dhcp_relay_destination (Data Source)

DHCP relay destinations (Services > DHCP Relay > Destinations).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the destination.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Unique name for this relay destination.
- `servers` (Set of String) A list of server IP addresses to relay DHCP requests to.
